dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Daniel! Do you need a hand?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ˈdænjəl! duː juː ˈniːd ə ˈhænd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, please. We need to set up the room before the children arrive.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. wiː ˈniːd tə ˈsɛt ˈʌp ðə ˈruːm bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈtʃɪldrən əˈraɪv.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let me carry those boxes for you. They look heavy.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈkæri ðoʊz ˈbɑːksɪz fər ˈjuː. ðeɪ ˈlʊk ˈhɛvi.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thanks. They're full of supplies: pencils, notebooks and erasers.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ðɛr ˈfʊl əv səˈplaɪz: ˈpɛnsəlz, ˈnoʊtbʊks ənd ɪˈreɪsərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: On the tables at the back. Then could you help me set up the speakers?
dialogue.reading: ɑːn ðə ˈteɪbəlz ət ðə ˈbæk. ˈðɛn kʊd juː ˈhɛlp miː ˈsɛt ˈʌp ðə ˈspiːkərz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. Let me get my phone. I have some English songs for the kids.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈlɛt miː ˈɡɛt maɪ ˈfoʊn. aɪ ˈhæv sʌm ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈsɔːŋz fər ðə ˈkɪdz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great idea. Who organized all these games?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt aɪˈdiːə. ˈhuː ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd ˈɔːl ðiːz ˈɡeɪmz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My friend Ploy and I did. We made a plan last night.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈplɔɪ ənd aɪ ˈdɪd. wiː ˈmeɪd ə ˈplæn ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nice work. When the kids come in, can you hand out the name tags?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs ˈwɜːrk. wɛn ðə ˈkɪdz ˈkʌm ˈɪn, kən juː ˈhænd ˈaʊt ðə ˈneɪm ˌtæɡz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me write the names first.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈlɛt miː ˈraɪt ðə ˈneɪmz ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Perfect. You two are very organized!
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt. juː ˈtuː ər ˈvɛri ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd!
